int[][] games := [
    [8, 1, 10, 7, 3, 9, 0, 10, 10, 2, 6, 6, 4, 0, 9, 10, 7, 2],
    [3, 4, 5, 2, 7, 1, 0, 6, 8, 1, 4, 4, 2, 3, 6, 2, 9, 0, 1, 5],
    [5, 5, 0, 10, 7, 3, 9, 1, 6, 4, 8, 2, 3, 7, 4, 6, 1, 9, 7, 3, 5],
    [10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10],
    [10, 9, 1, 10, 10, 7, 2, 0, 0, 10, 8, 1, 10, 6, 4, 10],
]
for: rolls := games[game]
    index := 0
    total := 0
    print("game {game + 1}:")
    for: frame < 10
        if frame == 9
            total += rolls[index:].sum()
        elif rolls[index] == 10
            total += 10 + rolls[index + 1] + rolls[index + 2]
            index += 1
        else
            pins := rolls[index] + rolls[index + 1]
            total += pins
            if pins == 10
                total += rolls[index + 2]
            index += 2
        print(" {total}")
    println()
